title: Microsoft Teams: Copilot in the Queues app on mobile
summary: Hold: the recording PowerShell command omits a private-preview restriction and a warning that saving through Teams admin center removes its setting. The blanket statement that Microsoft has not documented Copilot interaction storage or auditing also overlooks published Purview guidance; distinguish that guidance from unconfirmed mobile Queues-specific details.

claims.claim: Set-CsCallQueue -Identity <Guid> -AutoRecordingTemplateId <String> is presented as an unqualified automation equivalent for assigning a recording template.
claims.quote:
### -AutoRecordingTemplateId
Voice applications private preview customers only.
Saving a call queue configuration through Teams admin center will remove this setting.
claims.fix: Keep the real cmdlet and parameters, but qualify controls[0].note and the rendered row: the PowerShell reference restricts -AutoRecordingTemplateId to Voice applications private-preview customers and warns that saving the queue through Teams admin center removes it. Report that this conflicts with the setup page's August 13, 2026 statement that automatic recording can be configured through PowerShell; do not present unrestricted availability as settled.

claims.claim: General Teams-call Copilot configuration is at Teams admin center > Voice > Calling policies > policy > Copilot.
claims.quote:
Expand Voice from the navigation pane.
Under Voice, select Calling policies.
Either select an existing policy or create a new one.
From the dropdown for the Copilot setting, select On, On with saved transcript required, or Off.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsCallingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -Copilot Disabled turns off Copilot for calls covered by that calling policy.
claims.quote:
To turn off Copilot for calls, use the following command:
Set-CsTeamsCallingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -Copilot Disabled

claims.claim: The calling-policy documentation covers 1:1 and PSTN calls but does not confirm application to Copilot in Queues shared call history.
claims.quote: Searched: "Copilot" "Queues app" disable policy PowerShell; "Copilot" "Queues app" "mobile" policy disable permissions. Opened copilot-teams-calling-transcription and Set-CsTeamsCallingPolicy; neither places Queues shared-history Copilot under this policy.

claims.where: Open questions: Copilot questions and answers storage
claims.claim: Microsoft has not said whether Copilot questions and answers on a call are stored or where administrators can find them.
claims.quote: Data from generative AI messages is stored in a hidden folder in the mailbox of the user who runs the AI app.
claims.fix: Replace the blanket 'Microsoft has not said' with the documented general framework: Microsoft 365 Copilot prompts and responses are covered by Purview retention, with compliance copies in hidden Exchange mailbox folders searchable through eDiscovery. Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/retention-policies-copilot. Keep only the narrower open question of mobile Queues-specific behavior or exceptions not documented by these general pages.

claims.where: Open questions: Copilot questions and answers auditing
claims.claim: Microsoft has not said whether Copilot call interactions are audited or where administrators can see them.
claims.quote: The system automatically generates audit logs when a user interacts with Copilot, Cowork, or an AI application.
claims.fix: Acknowledge Microsoft's general Copilot audit documentation: with organizational auditing enabled, Copilot interactions are logged and can be searched through Audit in the Microsoft Purview portal. Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/audit-copilot. Limit the open question to Queues-mobile-specific identifiers, completeness or exceptions that Microsoft has not separately documented; do not claim no auditing guidance exists.

claims.claim: The prepare action rating fits the page's verified rollout timing and medium licensing cost.
claims.quote: action: "prepare"; cost: "medium"; Targeted Release begins late November 2026; Plan the licence assignments and the communication to queue teams before the Targeted Release window opens
claims.fix: Change action to act-now: on the November 16 run date, automatic rollout is within about 60 days and the page rates cost medium while identifying licence and recording decisions before rollout. This follows the action scale, not a mandatory Message Center deadline.

claims.fix: Add a controls row for per-user licence assignments covering Microsoft 365 Copilot, Teams Premium and Teams Phone, with researched admin UI and automation documentation. The current rows cover recording, calling policy and app availability but not this checklist control.
